title: Nations Spread Out Over the Earth

request.style: English, male baritone soul voice with gospel choir, Hammond organ, upright bass, brushed drums, strings, slow ballad mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
This is the family line of Noah
Shem and Ham and Japheth
Sons were born to them after the flood

[Pre-Chorus]
Coastland peoples spread out into their lands
Each with its own language
By their clans within their nations

[Chorus]
From these the nations spread out over the earth
Shem and Ham and Japheth
Nations spread out over the earth

[Verse]
The sons of Ham Cush Egypt Put
And Canaan
Cush fathered Nimrod mighty on the earth

[Pre-Chorus]
He was a mighty hunter before the LORD
Beginning of his kingdom was Babel
Erech Akkad and Calneh in Shinar

[Chorus]
From these the nations spread out over the earth
Shem and Ham and Japheth
Nations spread out over the earth

[Verse]
Sons were also born to Shem
Father of all the sons of Eber
Elam Asshur Arpachshad Lud and Aram

[Pre-Chorus]
Arpachshad fathered Shelah and Shelah fathered Eber
Peleg named for the divided earth
Joktan fathered many sons

[Chorus]
From these the nations spread out over the earth
Shem and Ham and Japheth
Nations spread out over the earth

[Bridge]
Clans of Noah sons by family lines
Within their nations

[Outro]
From these the nations spread out over the earth
After the flood
